# Onda for Mac 1.1.0 beta 121 — Apple Music
- Use Apple Music alongside Spotify: choose Automatic, Spotify or Apple Music on Listen. - See the current song, artist and album artwork, with Play/Pause, Previous and Next controls. - Include your saved room speakers in Room Fill for local Music playback. - Music pauses around recognized calls and supported video playback, then resumes when your saved listening route is ready. Music that was already paused stays paused. - A separate macOS Automation approval lets Onda read Music details and control playback. Retry in Onda requests the native approval; speaker settings and tuning are retained.
This universal Mac beta is signed, notarized and stapled. The audio driver remains 1.0.5 build 6; this update needs no new driver. Updates install on normal quit and keep existing settings.
Verified with local Music tracks, artwork and controls, a Bluetooth Sonos Move plus two Studio Displays, muted Google Meet calls, rejoining and Rollside playback/return. Apple Music subscription streams and every speaker configuration have not been verified. Protected or unauthorised tracks may need attention in Music itself.
The iPhone companion and its App Store submission are unchanged.
